mina_cs: Heads-up: Fluxware POC seeing a brief window of 401s followed by a sustained 429 spike during serverless hot-start warmup. Errors begin ~20-35s after cold starts. Can eng triage?
rao_eng: can you paste the warmup request and any logs? 401 -> 429 during warmup usually token rotation overlap + preflight fanout.
mina_cs: their minimal warmup request: 
```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>
Content-Type: application/json
{"model":"rwd-embed-2b","input":"warmup"}
```
They mint ephemeral tokens every 20s and spin up 12 parallel warmup goroutines on cold start. After ~7-8 successful calls we see a couple 401s then a flood of 429s for ~60-120s.
diag-bot: Alert: fluxware-poc (client_id: flx-9001) 5m 429 rate jumped 1% -> 43% at 3629997832. Top route: /v1/embeddings.
kevin_se: quick hypothesis: concurrent token refresh races produce some short/empty Authorization headers -> 401. Immediate retries + concurrent warmup pushes them past soft per-key concurrency and we return 429. Also check their sidecar for header truncation.
sophie_ae: FYI this POC is priority; renewal decision in 4 weeks. If onboarding stalls >48h escalate to AE.
rao_eng: customer-facing mitigation checklist we can hand them now:
- Cache ephemeral token per process/worker for >= 75-95s to avoid overlapping refreshes.
- Add jittered exponential backoff for 401 responses instead of instant retry.
- Reduce warmup parallelism (try 3-4 concurrent warmups).
- Add a 1s debounce/coalesce for identical warmup requests in their sidecar.
Share this Go snippet: 
```go
cfg := redwood.DefaultConfig()
cfg.TokenProvider = cachedProvider(90*time.Second) // cache per process
cfg.MaxOutstandingRequests = 5
cfg.AuthRetry = AuthRetry{Attempts:3, BaseDelay:200*time.Millisecond, Jitter:true}
client := redwood.NewClient(cfg)
```

mina_cs: they can ship the SDK change but asked for a short-term fallback while they roll it out.
kevin_se: if they can't change quickly ops can temporarily: +2 soft concurrency slots for flx-9001 and enable a 30-45s token-grace window for that key. Ops approval required; do not leave open indefinitely.
rao_eng: plan: 1) send Go snippet + debounce suggestion to customer now, 2) ask them to deploy to staging and run 40 sequential warmups (no parallel) and report 429 rate after 20m, 3) if 429 rate >25% request ops temporary cap bump. Call scheduled in 60m to review.
sophie_ae: keep me in the loop; escalate to AE if no improvement in 24h.
mina_cs: Action items: Mina -> customer message + call; Rao -> ops escalation draft; Kevin -> small how-to note on debounce.
